resolve: Provides an icon from the Nephos core with consistent size, family and accessibility, without introducing color or artwork outside the approved collection.
use_quando: A control or content needs an icon that exists in the core.
The icon reinforces a label, state or direction without replacing the textual information.
nao_use_quando: The action has a consequence or is domain-specific — use a text label alongside.
The icon you need does not exist in the core: record the gap and ask.

name.restricao: In kebab-case, and limited to the core names. A name outside the core does not render and emits an error only in development.

variant.restricao: `regular` is the default; `solid` is available for every name in the collection. I7 authorized `circle-info` in `solid` because the regular outline disappears next to text, especially in light mode. Light, Thin and Sharp do not exist in the contract.

size.restricao: Reflects as an attribute because the internal CSS selects the box by it. It does not accept a free value and has no default — when absent, the icon does not render.

label.restricao: Absent, empty or whitespace-only makes the icon decorative and applies `aria-hidden`. A non-empty value becomes the accessible name.

api.cor: It is not a property. It inherits `currentColor` from the context — there is no icon color token.

variant.escolha_quando: regular by default; solid when the context asks for greater visual presence

size.escolha_quando: sm inside a control and cell; md in menu and tab; lg when the icon carries meaning on its own

nao_se_aplica.muda_para_a_pessoa: The state belongs to the control that consumes the icon, not to the icon

dicas_para_ia: An action with a consequence never takes an icon alone — add text.
Do not look for a color property: it does not exist, the icon inherits from the context.
An icon next to text is decorative: leave `label` empty.
An icon alone in a control: the `label` goes on the control, not on the icon.

acessibilidade.semantica: No role of its own. Decorative by default
acessibilidade.nome_acessivel: Comes from `label`; empty marks it as decorative and applies aria-hidden
acessibilidade.foco: It never receives focus. Focus belongs to the enclosing control
acessibilidade.alternativa_a_cor: An icon is never the only signal of a state

anti_padroes: An icon alone in an action with a consequence
Painting the icon with a color other than the context color
Using a size outside the three tokens
Simulating Duotone with artwork or an empty variant

fontes.decisao: P21, adopted by Indiane on 26-08-2026; I7, 08-09-2026
